# Joint National Committee for Languages (JNCL)

> > JNCL advocates for multilingual America through federal language policy advocacy, member organization networks, and educational initiatives.

JNCL is a coalition of 130+ language organizations representing language professionals, educators, and advocates working to advance language education and multilingual competency in the United States. The organization focuses on federal advocacy, legislative outreach, and building support for language policy on Capitol Hill.

## Organization Overview

- [Language | Joint National Committee for Languages | United States](https://www.languagepolicy.org): JNCL homepage advocating for multilingual America and language policy.
- [ABOUT US | Joint National Committee for Languages | United States](https://www.languagepolicy.org/about): JNCL organizational mission and network of language professionals.
- [Our Story | Joint National Committee for Languages | United States](https://www.languagepolicy.org/our-story): JNCL history since 1972 and coalition of language education organizations.
- [MEMBERSHIP | Joint National Committee for Languages | United States](https://www.languagepolicy.org/membership): JNCL membership benefits and network of 130+ language organizations.
- [JNCL-NCLIS Board Members](https://www.languagepolicy.org/board): JNCL board leadership and executive committee organizational governance.

## Advocacy & Policy Work

- [ADVOCACY | JNCL](https://www.languagepolicy.org/advocacy-resources): Free advocacy resources for language education policy and appropriations.
- [Advocacy Tool Kit | JNCL](https://www.languagepolicy.org/advocacytoolkit): Advocacy toolkit for state-level language education legislative outreach.
- [Our Impact Timeline | JNCL](https://www.languagepolicy.org/jnclimpacttimeline): JNCL federal advocacy wins and language policy legislative achievements.
- [America's Languages Caucus | JNCL](https://www.languagepolicy.org/americaslanguages): Congressional caucus for language policy and multilingual education.

## Events & Conferences

- [EVENTS | Joint National Committee for Languages | United States](https://www.languagepolicy.org/events): JNCL conferences, workshops, webinars and community engagement events.
- [LAD26 | JNCL](https://www.languagepolicy.org/lad26): Language Advocacy Days 2026 conference in Washington D.C.
- [LAD Keynote Speaker | JNCL-NCLIS](https://www.languagepolicy.org/ladkeynotespeaker): LAD26 keynote speaker Carla Dirlikov Canales on cultural diplomacy.

## Research & Data

- [K-12 Survey Findings | JNCL](https://www.languagepolicy.org/k-12surveyfindings): K-12 language program survey findings and advocacy recommendations.

## Recognition & Support

- [Awards | Joint National Committee for Languages | United States](https://www.languagepolicy.org/awards): JNCL awards recognizing excellence in language education and advocacy.
- [Donate | JNCL](https://www.languagepolicy.org/donate): Donation and fundraising page for JNCL nonprofit organization.
- [Scholarship Donations](https://forms.languagepolicy.org/campaigns/scholarship-donations): Scholarship donation campaign and charitable giving platform.
